intent: Pick a calendar date and a time in one field.
useWhen: An appointment, deadline, or schedule that needs both a day and a time
doNotUseWhen: A range of dates — use DateRangePicker

value.note: date is YYYY-MM-DD. time is HH:mm.

name.note: Hidden input submits date and time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

requirements: Escape closes only this panel, not a parent Modal, Drawer or AlertDialog
Trigger is a button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, and aria-controls
The dialog contains the month grid and a TimePicker
Choosing a day or a time updates the value and leaves the dialog open until Done or Escape
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
Must have a Field label pointing at id
built-in labels (previousMonth, nextMonth, chooseDateAndTime, time) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not use two fields when one DateTimePicker is the control
Do not invent a local calendar or a native datetime-local input
